description: Static workflow-discipline assertions per agent role. Each schema defines markers that the role's prompt.md and/or its runtime adapters must contain (must_contain) or must avoid (must_not_contain). The check is static — it scans file content, not agent runtime output. The contract: if these markers are present in the prompt/adapter source, an agent following the source is structurally inclined toward the desired first-turn shape. Dynamic eval (actually running the agent and inspecting output) is a separate future concern; this file defines the shape declarations that dynamic eval would also use.

investigator-first-turn.description: Investigator first turn: parse framing, propose loads, halt at checkpoint, do not diagnose.
must_contain_in_prompt: first response is a **plan**, not a diagnosis

architect-first-turn.description: Architect first turn: produce recommendation register, propose changes only (no tenant mutation), calibrate confidence to evidence layer.

auditor-first-turn.description: Auditor first turn: produce audit register from read-only review; do not edit files mid-audit.

soc-first-turn.description: SOC first turn: produce posture register; threat-model context required for High/Critical findings.
